name: Rowland Strong
bio: A Paris-based English journalist of the exile years, correspondent for the Observer and the New York Times, who in September 1898 published Esterhazy's confession that he had written the bordereau at the heart of the Dreyfus affair. Two of Wilde's letters to him survive, both from the spring of 1898, both about The Ballad of Reading Gaol.
bio_note: Two letters (printed 1027). The Dreyfus connection is from the editors' note and is context only; nothing about Wilde's part in it is asserted here.
